market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Fed hike + 5%+ yields + oil surge create headwinds for equities. Bond market extreme positioning risks sharp unwind. Crypto weak post-CLARITY failure. Gold/silver bid strong. Expect 2-4% equity volatility over next 30 days. Trump-Fed conflict adds political noise.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for selective sectors. AI monetization (Meta, Nvidia) supports tech leaders. India IPO cycle and yuan global push offer EM opportunities. Energy transition (nuclear, data center power) is multi-year theme. But inflation reacceleration from oil and food risks could force further Fed tightening, pressuring valuations through 2027.
